s: The First Dark turns its whole attention on ${t.name}. It is trying to forget them. (A Ribbon or Purify will save them.)
Red Tam points at ${t.name}. "You. Yes, you. You're getting the Legendary Haymaker." He cracks his knuckles. Slowly.
Garrick levels his sword at ${t.name}. "You first." (Protect them, or heal them now.)
${c.self.name} hums the first note of the Vespersong. (Get ready.)
Hollow Wren raises her sword at ${t.name}, exactly the way you would.
